executive_summary.scope: Phase 1 delivers a functional MVP with 25+ MCP tools across 6 categories, HTTP/JSON-RPC communication layer, and 3-module Web UI dashboard for monitoring and server control

sprints.name: Foundation & Communication
sprints.objective: Establish HTTP/JSON-RPC communication between Node.js and Godot with MCP protocol integration, plus basic Web UI server

technical_tasks.name: Node.js MCP Server Setup
steps: Install MCP SDK, undici, zod, winston, express, cors
Implement MCP server skeleton using SDK
Setup stdio transport for MCP protocol
acceptance_criteria: MCP server starts and accepts stdio connections

technical_tasks.name: Godot Bridge HTTP Server
steps: Implement HTTPServer GDScript class listening on port 7777
acceptance_criteria: Logs include timestamps and severity levels

technical_tasks.name: Web UI Server Setup
steps: Setup static file serving from public/ directory
Create basic HTML dashboard with Alpine.js + Tailwind CSS CDN
Test SSE connection with browser DevTools
acceptance_criteria: Express server starts on configured port
Dashboard displays in browser without errors

technical_tasks.name: Communication Layer
steps: Implement Node.js HTTP client using undici Pool
Configure keep-alive connections and pooling (10 concurrent)
Error handling (network errors, HTTP codes, JSON-RPC codes)
Retry logic with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, max 3 retries)
Connection pool management with health checks (30s)
acceptance_criteria: Node.js can send HTTP POST to Godot HTTPServer
Network failures trigger retry with backoff
Node.js can send HTTP POST to Godot HTTPServer
Health check returns 200 OK with uptime
risk_validation: Latency test: Benchmark 1000 requests, confirm p99 <50ms
Stability test: Run for 1 hour continuous, confirm no memory leaks
Compatibility: Test on Windows, macOS, Linux
security_considerations: Input validation on all JSON-RPC requests

sprints.name: Editor Control Tools
sprints.objective: Implement editor launch, project execution, and version detection tools

technical_tasks.name: Godot Editor Launcher
steps: Define JSON Schema for launch_godot_editor (project_path, editor_executable, additional_args)
Platform-specific default locations (Windows: C:\Program Files\Godot\, macOS: /Applications/Godot.app, Linux: /usr/local/bin/godot)
Return process PID, editor version, project name
Handle errors: executable not found, project invalid
acceptance_criteria: Editor launches successfully with correct project
Returns valid PID and project metadata

technical_tasks.name: Project Execution & Control
steps: Optional scene parameter and debug port configuration (default 6007)
Create unique stream ID for output management
Buffer output in memory (ring buffer, 10MB limit)
acceptance_criteria: Projects run in debug mode with output capture
SIGKILL sent after timeout if needed

technical_tasks.name: Version Detection & Project Discovery
steps: Extract version, mono flag, executable path
Implement recursive directory scan for project.godot files
Count scenes, scripts, assets by type
acceptance_criteria: Project discovery finds all projects in directory tree

technical_tasks.name: Tool Registration
steps: Register all 6 tools with MCP SDK
Write unit tests for each tool (mock child_process)
acceptance_criteria: All tools return valid MCP responses
Error messages are clear and actionable
Editor launches successfully with correct project
Projects run in debug mode with output capture
Project discovery finds all projects in directory tree
All tools return valid MCP responses
Error messages are clear and actionable
risk_validation: Platform compatibility: Test on Windows/macOS/Linux
Edge cases: Test with non-existent paths, corrupted projects
Performance: Project analysis completes in <5s for 1000-file projects
security_considerations: Path traversal prevention for project_path parameter

sprints.name: Read Tools - Core Features
sprints.objective: Implement scene and script read operations with caching, plus Web UI lifecycle controls and real-time monitoring
deliverables: Web UI: Real-time log streaming via SSE

technical_tasks.name: Tool Schema Definitions
steps: Define JSON Schemas for all 5 read tools using Zod

technical_tasks.name: Scene Operations
steps: Implement list_scenes using DirAccess for recursive scan
Return array with path, name, optional metadata
Build JSON node hierarchy with parent/child relationships
Handle binary scenes (.scn) - return metadata only
Handle malformed files - return parse error
Implement caching: key=file path, value=parsed JSON+checksum
Invalidation on file modification timestamp change
acceptance_criteria: .tscn files parsed into complete JSON (nodes + properties)
Cache reduces latency by >50% for repeated reads
Parser handles real-world Godot projects (tested with 10+ projects)

technical_tasks.name: Script Operations
steps: Return: path, language, size, modified timestamp
Extract metadata: class_name, extends, signals, constants, @export vars, functions
Return content with line ranges for each element
Handle C# scripts (basic support - content + class info)
acceptance_criteria: Function signatures extracted with parameter types
Handles both GDScript and C# files

technical_tasks.name: Project Structure Tool
steps: For each entry: name, type (file/directory), size, modified
Add optional metadata flags: include_hidden, max_depth
acceptance_criteria: Tree structure accurately represents file system

technical_tasks.name: Web UI - Lifecycle Controls & Basic Monitoring
steps: Return: success status, PID, timestamp, connection count
Create Alpine.js dashboard component with status badge
Enhance SSE endpoint with log filtering (debug/info/warn/error)
Create log viewer UI component with EventSource connection
Add connection tracking (client names, connection times, request counts)
Style with Tailwind CSS: status badges, responsive grid, dark mode logs
acceptance_criteria: Connection status displayed with active client count
SSE connection stable for >1 hour without disconnects
Log viewer supports filtering and auto-scroll
All 5 read tools return valid MCP responses
.tscn files parsed into complete JSON (nodes + properties)
Tools handle missing files gracefully (JSON-RPC -32001 error)
Cache reduces latency by >50% for repeated reads
Parser handles real-world Godot projects (tested with 10+ projects)
Web UI: Real-time logs streaming via SSE
Web UI: Connection status displayed with active client count
risk_validation: Format compatibility: Test with Godot 4.0-4.6 .tscn files
Performance: Read 100-node scene in <100ms
Memory: Cache stays within 50MB limit
Web UI: SSE connection stable for >1 hour without disconnects
security_considerations: Path validation for all file operations

sprints.name: Node Operations & Search + Web UI Tool Explorer
sprints.objective: Implement node search, property inspection, MCP resources, and interactive Web UI tool exploration module
deliverables: search_nodes tool (by name, type, property, group)
Web UI Module 1: Tool Exploration & Invocation

technical_tasks.name: Node Search Tool
steps: Apply criteria filters (name regex, type exact match, property comparison, group membership)
Build result set with node paths
Return results with scene_path, node_path, type, properties
Optimize for large projects: lazy loading, result limit (100), search timeout (10s)
acceptance_criteria: search_nodes finds nodes across all scenes
Wildcard and regex matching works correctly

technical_tasks.name: Property Inspection
steps: Implement get_node_properties (scene path + node path input)
Return all properties with types and values
Serialize as JSON-compatible structures with type annotations
Support property filtering (optional properties array parameter)
acceptance_criteria: get_node_properties returns complete property list with types
Complex types serialized correctly (Vector2, Color, etc.)
Filtered queries return only requested properties

technical_tasks.name: MCP Resources
steps: Define URI scheme: godot://scenes/{path}, godot://scripts/{path}, godot://resources/{path}
Return resources with URI, name, mimeType
Implement resource read handler (parse URI, call appropriate tool)
Return content as text or JSON
Add resource subscription support (file watcher for changes)
acceptance_criteria: MCP resources accessible via godot:// URIs
File watcher detects changes and emits notifications

technical_tasks.name: Web UI - Tool Exploration & Invocation Module
steps: Implement tool catalog API endpoint: GET /api/tools
Return all tools with name, description, inputSchema
Return result with execution_time_ms and timestamp
Build interactive tool catalog component with search bar
Create tools grid with card layout
Display tool details panel with description and parameters
Generate dynamic form from JSON Schema
Implement tool invocation with loading state
Display results in syntax-highlighted pre block
Style with Tailwind CSS: card layout, syntax highlighting, validation states
acceptance_criteria: Tool catalog displays all available tools
Dynamic form generates inputs from JSON Schema
search_nodes finds nodes across all scenes
Wildcard and regex matching works correctly
get_node_properties returns complete property list with types
MCP resources accessible via godot:// URIs
Web UI: Tool catalog displays all available tools
Web UI: Dynamic form generation from JSON Schema
Web UI: Tool invocation works with real-time results
risk_validation: Search performance: Benchmark with 1000+ scenes
Property serialization: Test with all Godot types
Web UI: Cross-browser compatibility (Chrome, Firefox, Safari)
Schema validation: Test with invalid inputs
security_considerations: Search query injection prevention (sanitize regex patterns)
Argument validation against JSON Schema (prevent injection)
Rate limiting on tool invocation endpoint (max 10 req/min)

sprints.name: Write Tools - Scene Operations
sprints.objective: Implement scene creation and modification with backup system

technical_tasks.name: Scene Creation
steps: Define create_scene schema (path, root_node, overwrite flag)
Implement scene generator (build .tscn text format from JSON)
Validation before creation: check node types exist, validate property types, prevent overwrite unless flagged
acceptance_criteria: New scenes created with valid .tscn format
Scenes open correctly in Godot editor

technical_tasks.name: Scene Modification
steps: Define modify_scene schema (path, operations array, create_backup flag)
Implement operations: add_node, remove_node, update_property, connect_signal
Operation execution: load scene, apply sequentially, validate after each
Preserve scene formatting: maintain comments, keep ext_resource order, preserve sub_resource definitions

technical_tasks.name: Backup System
steps: Backup rotation: keep last 5 versions per file, delete oldest
Storage limit enforcement: 100MB per project, warn when approaching

technical_tasks.name: Validation Layer
steps: Validate before all write operations: JSON Schema, node type validation, property type validation, path traversal prevention
Implement validate_scene tool: check syntax, check dependencies (scripts/resources exist), check for broken NodePaths
Optional checks: circular dependencies, deprecated properties
acceptance_criteria: Invalid operations rejected with clear JSON-RPC errors
Validation catches common errors before write
New scenes created with valid .tscn format
Scenes open correctly in Godot editor
Invalid operations rejected with clear JSON-RPC errors
Validation catches common errors before write
risk_validation: Scene format compatibility: Test with Godot 4.6+
Backup system: Test with large files (>10MB)
Atomic transactions: Test rollback scenarios
Validation: Test with invalid node types and properties

sprints.name: Write Tools - Script Operations
sprints.objective: Implement script creation, modification, and syntax validation

technical_tasks.name: Script Creation
steps: Implement templates: empty, node, character_body_2d, area_2d, resource
Auto-attach to scene: if scene path provided, update .tscn with script property
acceptance_criteria: Scripts created with valid GDScript syntax

technical_tasks.name: Script Modification
steps: Implement line-based operations: replace, insert, delete
High-level operations: add_function, add_signal, add_property (translate to line-based)
Format preservation: maintain style (tabs vs spaces), preserve blank lines, keep comments

technical_tasks.name: GDScript Syntax Validation
steps: Implement syntax checker (Option 1: godot --check-only, Option 2: regex-based parser)
Extract: error type, line, column, message
Validation caching: cache results for 1 minute, invalidate on modification
acceptance_criteria: Error messages include line and column numbers

technical_tasks.name: Integration & Testing
steps: Integrate all script tools with MCP
Write comprehensive tests: test each template type, test modification operations, test syntax validation

acceptance_criteria: Scripts created with valid GDScript syntax
risk_validation: Template compatibility: Test with Godot 4.6+
Syntax validation: Test with valid and invalid scripts
Performance: Test with large scripts (>1000 lines)
Encoding: Test with UTF-8, special characters

technical_challenges.challenge: Complex resource format with sub_resources, ext_resources, and nested nodes
technical_challenges.mitigation: Build incremental parser, test with real projects, extensive unit tests

technical_challenges.challenge: Low-latency requirements (<20ms p99) for localhost communication
technical_challenges.mitigation: Connection pooling, keep-alive, benchmark early, optimize hot paths

technical_challenges.challenge: Maintaining SSE connection for >1 hour without disconnects
technical_challenges.mitigation: Heartbeat mechanism, automatic reconnection, connection state management

technical_challenges.challenge: Ensuring rollback on failure for multi-operation transactions
technical_challenges.mitigation: Transactional wrapper, backup before modifications, extensive testing

technical_challenges.challenge: Spawning Godot processes on Windows/macOS/Linux with consistent behavior
technical_challenges.mitigation: Platform-specific testing, CI/CD on all platforms, process isolation

high_risks.risk: Godot .tscn format changes in future versions
high_risks.mitigation: Version detection, format compatibility layer, extensive testing across Godot 4.0-4.6

high_risks.risk: Performance degradation with large projects (>1000 scenes)
high_risks.mitigation: Lazy loading, pagination, result limits, early performance testing

medium_risks.mitigation: Automatic reconnection, heartbeat, connection state management
LRU eviction, memory limits, long-running stability tests
Strict path validation, allowlisting, security audit, penetration testing

low_risks.mitigation: Pin versions, CDN fallbacks, minimal custom CSS

authentication.recommendation: Implement in Phase 2 for remote deployments

validation: All paths validated against project root

data_validation.input: Zod schemas for all tool parameters
data_validation.sanitization: Path normalization, regex escaping, command injection prevention

critical_security_controls.implementation: No shell=true, argument validation, no string interpolation
Block autoload/, addons/, .godot/ writes, file extension validation
Web UI endpoints: 10 req/min per IP, tool invocation: 5 req/min
Checksums, versioning, storage limits, isolated directory

threat_mitigations.mitigation: Strict path validation, allowlist, no symlinks, audit logging
Static analysis, developer review, content filtering (OS.execute, HTTPRequest)
Result limits, search timeouts, cache size limits, rate limiting
Isolated .godot/mcp-backups/ directory, storage limits, integrity checks

implementation_recommendation.rationale: Phase 1 spans 6 sprints with distinct deliverables, multiple teams can work in parallel, clear dependencies between sprints, easier tracking and code review

suggested_issues.title: [Sprint 1] Foundation & Communication Layer
suggested_issues.description: Implement HTTP/JSON-RPC communication between Node.js MCP server and Godot bridge, plus basic Web UI server with SSE support

suggested_issues.title: [Sprint 2] Editor Control Tools (6 Tools)
suggested_issues.description: Implement 6 editor control tools: launch_godot_editor, run_godot_project, stop_godot_execution, get_godot_version, list_godot_projects, analyze_project

suggested_issues.title: [Sprint 3] Read Tools & Web UI Lifecycle Controls
suggested_issues.description: Implement 5 read tools (list_scenes, read_scene, list_scripts, read_script, get_project_structure) with LRU cache, plus Web UI lifecycle controls and real-time monitoring

suggested_issues.title: [Sprint 4] Node Operations & MCP Resources + Tool Explorer UI
suggested_issues.description: Implement search_nodes, get_node_properties, MCP resource URIs (godot://), and interactive Web UI tool exploration module with dynamic forms

suggested_issues.title: [Sprint 5] Write Tools - Scene Operations & Backup System
suggested_issues.description: Implement create_scene, modify_scene with atomic transactions, automatic backup system, and scene validation layer

suggested_issues.title: [Sprint 6] Write Tools - Script Operations & Validation
suggested_issues.description: Implement create_script with templates, modify_script with line-based editing, GDScript syntax validation, and script attachment to scenes

suggested_issues.title: [Phase 1] Security Hardening & Testing
suggested_issues.description: Security audit (path traversal, injection, rate limiting), performance testing (latency benchmarks, memory leak tests), cross-platform validation, documentation
